MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  October 27, 2025

Staff Liaison Amber Bulosan called the meeting to order at 5:07 p.m. in Conference Room
4, Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll
call were Commissioner Carbajal, Commissioner Flores, Commissioner Salas, and
Commissioner Gomez. Also, present was Ozzie Ramos, Deputy City Manager and
Svetlana Hernandez, Office Assistant I.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

No minutes were approved at this meeting given that the last meeting was held in 2012
and involved different Commissioners.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  None
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None
ABSTAIN:  None

REPORTS

Commission Introduction

Ms. Bulosan welcomed the Commissioners to the meeting and opened a round table for
a brief introduction. All four commissioners introduced themselves and explained their
interest in joining the Commission. A copy of the Advisory Body Guide was provided to
the Commissioners.

Ms. Bulosan shared a PowerPoint presentation introducing the International Friendship
Commission. The PowerPoint highlighted the roles of the Commissioners, explained the
purpose of the International Friendship Commission, informed them of who the previous
sister cities were along with previous programs the prior Commission took part in or were
interested in and provided a brief description of the SoCal Sister Cities Organization.
Those programs include a Pen pal program and interest in joining the International Sister
City Association.

Mission, Vision Statement

Ms. Bulosan shared with the Commission the City’s Vision and Mission Statement and
invited them to collaborate to create a new Vision and Mission Statement specific to the
International Friendship Commission. It was explained that this is the opportunity to set a
 precedent for the Commission by creating a purpose and goal. Commissioners were
invited to come up with ideas for the next meeting.

STAFF COMMENTS

Deputy City Manager, Ozzie Ramos, welcomed the Commissioners and further
explained the importance of the roles of a Commissioner as an advisory body and what
the purpose of a Vision and Mission statement is.

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS
Commissioner Flores expressed gratitude for staff support and excitement to revisit
previous programs, like the Pen pal program along with excitement for the reinstatement
of the International Friendship Commission.

Commissioner Carbajal expressed excitement and readiness for new program
implementation for the Commission.

Commissioner Gomez provided ideas for future programs, such as cultural exchanges
through music. He also invited the Commission to a cultural arts event.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment

ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:38 PM.

_______________________________
COMMISSIONER
Maria Carbajal
